digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store rotation tracking
propositions: Introduce a rotation module that loads/saves GET rotation state to .bridge_state/get_rotation.json while dual-writing the legacy inline field during rollout
Read chronological max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value) per Jira key and persist new stamps to both sidecar and legacy field
Wire BindingStore and outbound_differ to shared rotation accessors without exceeding 800-line module cap
Include GET_ROTATION_FILE in explicit local staging and basename membership checks so both dual-written files commit together
Preserve rollback: reverted old binary ignores sidecar but sees legacy field advanced by new-binary passes
After rotation initialization, idempotent real-repo passes with no absent-key GETs leave bridge-state files byte-identical without advancing HEAD
